comment_text: Thank you for the update on this story. In May 2025 the University of California Davis released a study that found 72% of Wolf scat contained Cattle remains and concluded Wolves prefer domesticated livestock like Cattle Goats and Sheep because they are more docile and slower than wildlife and therefore much easier to catch.
Capture the wolves and release them in downtown Denver. That is who voted for them.
This whole project was ill conceived and politically motivated. It  has since blossomed into an expensive and destructive fiasco for everyone not responsible for it, including many of the wolves.
